post_condition: Returns None when any of the configured LLM API key, base URL, model name, or provider identifier is missing or falsy. Otherwise returns a dictionary representing a single-provider OpenCode configuration block: outermost key is "provider", its value is a dict keyed by the configured provider identifier containing an npm AI SDK adapter selected according to the configured API style (Anthropic SDK adapter when the API style is "anthropic", OpenAI-compatible adapter otherwise), a base URL set to the configured value, an API key expressed as an environment-variable reference, and the configured model name registered as an available model.
